description:
Register a callback subscription

Registers a destination for verification results on the organization
the presented `OrgToken` resolves to. At least one subscription must
exist for the org before you can create a verification session.
Delivery is scoped by org: terminal results are ECIES-encrypted to the
org's eth public key when its `canEncryptResult` is enabled (see
`PUT /orgs/{orgId}/keypair`), else delivered as plaintext.

To receive results at a URL, send `callbackUrl` and `events`. Builder
POSTs each delivery to that URL.

To read results without a public URL during local development, send
`deliveryMode: "pull"`. Builder keeps the deliveries and you read them
with `GET /verifications/callback-events`. A pull subscription is a
90-second lease: it receives events and satisfies the session-creation
check only while the lease is unexpired. Send the same request about
every 30 seconds to renew it, and call
`POST /verifications/callback-listener/release` when you stop. Production
needs a webhook subscription. An org has at most one pull subscription.
If it already exists, Builder renews it and returns it with status 200.
If the body includes `events`, they replace the subscription's events;
if it omits them, the existing events are kept.

body.description: Body for `POST /verifications/callback-subscriptions`. The owning organization is resolved from the presented `OrgToken`; delivery is scoped to that org and encrypted to its credential when set. Send `callbackUrl` for a webhook, or `deliveryMode: "pull"` for a subscription you read.

oneOf.description: A subscription that Builder POSTs each delivery to.

callbackUrl.description: Callback URL or template. Supported placeholders are `{{sessionId}}` and top-level scalar context keys.

items.description: Canonical Builder lifecycle event. Names use lower snake case; metadata uses camel case. Provider events include providerId, resolvedVersion, and ordinal. Request events also include requestId. New values are additive, so clients must tolerate unknown response values. For field requirements and funnel semantics, see docs/verification-analytics-events.md.

oneOf.description: A subscription whose deliveries wait for you to read them. It has no URL. An org has at most one.

callbackUrl.description: Not allowed. A pull subscription has no URL.

events.description: Events to keep. Defaults to every event.

items.description: Canonical Builder lifecycle event. Names use lower snake case; metadata uses camel case. Provider events include providerId, resolvedVersion, and ordinal. Request events also include requestId. New values are additive, so clients must tolerate unknown response values. For field requirements and funnel semantics, see docs/verification-analytics-events.md.

orgToken.description: The organization API key (`rorg_…`) this call authenticates with: from `issue_org_token`, or the app's RECLAIM_ORG_SECRET. Defaults to the MCP server's RECLAIM_ORG_SECRET. Never echo it back to the user.
